McpServerConfig.description:
Configuration for a single MCP server.

The type lives in `kcoder_types` so config loading, CLI setup, and MCP connection code can share the same contract without depending on each other's implementation crates.

command.description: Command to execute for stdio transport.

headers.description: Additional request headers for `http` or an external `searxng` instance. Values are literal plaintext from settings without environment expansion; protect configuration-file permissions when they contain secrets.

transport.description: Transport type: `"stdio"`, `"sse"` for legacy dual-endpoint HTTP+SSE, `"http"` for single-endpoint Streamable HTTP, or `"searxng"` for bundled search.

url.description: Endpoint URL for `sse` or `http` transport, such as `http://localhost:3001/sse` or `https://example.com/mcp`. For `searxng`, leave empty to start the bundled service; an explicit URL uses that instance.

McpServerPolicy.description: Launch, visibility and credential-reference controls. These never contain secret values.

application_actions.description: Reviewed business semantics; effects still need final normal user approval.

oauth_account.description: Explicit local credential slot, independent of the external subject's display name.

task_resource_reads.description: Administrator-approved exact input semantics for resource-bound tasks. Server annotations never populate this map.

McpTaskResourceReadRule.description: The actual tool schema and complete input shape are pinned by the owner. Only the URI slot varies; an extra operation/write/send field is rejected.

MigrationMcpPrivateField.description: A source-declared private slot. Values and arbitrary environment lookups are never accepted.
